name: What is surface preparation for painting?

mainEntity.name: What is surface preparation for painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Surface preparation is the critical initial phase before applying any paint. It involves cleaning, repairing, and priming the surface to ensure proper adhesion and a durable finish. This can include washing, sanding, scraping loose paint, filling holes or cracks, and applying a suitable primer. Proper preparation prevents issues like peeling, blistering, and uneven finishes, extending the lifespan and appearance of your paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Surface preparation is the essential first step before painting, involving cleaning, repairing, and priming to ensure paint adhesion and a long-lasting, quality finish.
